name: Kloeckner & Co SE
summary: Klöckner & Co SE, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the distribution of steel and metal products in Germany, Switzerland, France, the United States, and internationally, through its Kloeckner Metals Americas and Kloeckner Metals Europe segments. Klöckner & Co SE was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Duisburg, Germany.
